test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ABCD is a quadrilateral in which diagonal BD = 62 cm, AL ⊥ BD and CM ⊥ BD, such that AL = 14.3 cm and CM = 17.7 cm. The area of the quadrilateral ABCD is:
solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal BD = 62 cm

AL ⊥ BD, AL = 14.3 cm

CM ⊥ BD, CM = 17.7 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of quadrilateral = 1/2 × diagonal × (sum of perpendiculars)

**Calculation:**

Area = 1/2 × BD × (AL + CM)

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 62 × (14.3 + 17.7)

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 62 × 32

⇒ Area = 31 × 32

⇒ Area = 992 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
